registryAssessment: The Fuzhou municipal Natural Resources Bureau explicitly assigns the Fuzhou Real Estate Registration Center responsibility for property registration in the city proper, Linchuan District, and two development zones, and for cadastral-survey support and registration-record management in those jurisdictions. This is direct city-bound registry evidence for Linchuan. Its portal lists online-query and registration services, but no safe anonymous parcel geometry endpoint/schema was verified.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Fuzhou Municipal Government / Natural Resources Bureau functions page (2026-05-07) says the municipal Real Estate Registration Center handles real-property registration and cadastral/record work for city proper, Linchuan District, and named development zones.

Official Fuzhou Real Estate Registration and Trading Center portal lists service guides, online-query services and registration announcements; it does not expose a public geometry schema on the landing page.
